name: SNeRG Deferred Shading Model
definition: Decomposes the radiance field into a 3D field of densities, diffuse RGB colors, and feature vectors to reduce MLP evaluations to one per ray. It volumetrically accumulates diffuse colors and features, then computes view-dependent color using a small MLP.
summary: SNeRG Deferred Shading Model is a real-time volumetric rendering method that reduces computational cost by deferring view-dependent appearance decoding to a lightweight MLP after accumulating view-independent features.
